text:
Situation: Famotidine 20 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 229 tablets (23.5 days on hand at 9.8 tablets per day). Corvale General holds 256 tablets (26.3 days on hand at 9.7 tablets per day). Corvale Lakeside holds 14 tablets (8.4 days on hand). The current label names Northwind Health Company, LLC as repackager at FEI 1831143, which received a VAI classification on 2025-09-26 and had an OAI classification in 2015.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows famotidine is not listed as of 2026-10-21. Northwind Health Company, LLC (FEI 1831143) received a VAI classification on 2025-09-26. The 2015 OAI classification is part of the plant's inspection history.

Our position: Current inventory at East and General provides adequate supply for approximately three to four weeks. Lakeside inventory is low at 8.4 days. The Northwind plant's inspection history, including the 2015 OAI and 2025 VAI, should be evaluated for supply reliability before committing to alternate sources. Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. is the first ranked alternate manufacturer but its label does not name a plant that can be placed.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate Northwind Health Company, LLC inspection history (2015 OAI, 2025 VAI) for supply reliability risk; requires P&T committee approval to proceed with current source.
2. Buyer to request plant location information from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. to assess manufacturing site reliability; requires P&T committee approval before purchase.
3. Buyer to monitor Lakeside inventory daily and coordinate transfer from East or General if days on hand fall below 14; requires pharmacy director approval.
4. Buyer to verify FDA shortage list weekly for status changes; requires no additional approval.

Not recommended: Purchasing from alternate manufacturers (Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, Ascend Laboratories LLC, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, AvPAK) without confirmed plant location and inspection history.
